source_note: Cropped from our own shipped/generated market plate (koh-samui v2). This is the canonical white-hull glass-cabin foiling N30 used across all SEA market backgrounds.
pose: bow-left rear-quarter, foils down (bow-right variant from langkawi v1)
lighting_rule: CRITICAL: the dusk/sunset tone in n30-reference.png is a PLATE property (market background + navy gradient overlay), NOT a property of the N30. Generate/composite the vessel NEUTRAL (light hull, glass cabin, daylight). The market plate sets time-of-day per market. Use n30-reference-neutral.png for hull color/form; use n30-reference.png only for pose/stance/geometry.

references.n30-reference-neutral.png: FORM + COLOR reference (Tier A image_edit only — never paste). Tint-neutralized + shadow-lifted crop recovering true light hull and daylight read. Match the VESSEL to this (hull color, cabin glass, V-mark, foil stance).
references.n30-reference-neutral-ALPHA.png: TIER C FALLBACK ONLY. True alpha hull cutout at 100% opacity; cabin glass neutral (no scenic bleed). Generated via Tier A background strip from neutral ref.
references.n30-reference.png: POSE + STANCE reference only (bow-left rear-quarter). Carries koh-samui dusk tint — do NOT match lighting to this.
references.n30-reference-bowright.png: Alternate POSE reference (bow-right), cropped from langkawi v1.

use: Reference-guided generation/compositing of the N30 into new market backgrounds. Match the vessel to the neutral reference; let the market plate set lighting.
neutralization: gamma 1/1.55 shadow lift + gray-world white balance + contrast 1.05 / saturation 0.92 (deterministic, see step in repo history)
supersedes: image47 (LuxuryHospitality deck) — rejected: wrong vessel/style, did not match shipped images
